Carousels: teaching brands to grow with strategy

This seven-slide carousel is Day 2 of my content calendar. It opens with a hook (“5 Reasons Your Business Is Posting But Not Growing”), gives one reason per slide and ends with a call to action: DM me “STRATEGY”.

What the carousel teaches

01

Consistency without strategy

Posting every day is not growth unless you know who you are targeting, what you want to achieve and why each post exists.

02

Not creating for your audience

Answer “what does my audience need to see?” by understanding their problems, questions, desires, pain points and buying decisions.

03

No clear content pillars

Choose three to five pillars, such as educational, industry insights, behind the scenes, social proof and promotional, so posts stay consistent without repeating.

04

Hooks that don’t stop the scroll

Swap generic titles for a hook that makes the viewer think “wait… that’s me.” People decide in the first few seconds.

05

No CTA or tracking

Give a clear next step (comment, save, share, DM, visit the site) and track reach, engagement, saves, shares, profile visits and leads.

Design choices: one idea per slide, a bold headline with the key phrase in blue, icons and short lists that are easy to scan, a swipe prompt on the cover and a clear CTA on the last slide. The closing message sums it up: your business doesn’t need more content, it needs better content with a strategy behind it.

Project: the Nexora Technologies brand world

A complete brand identity for a technology company that builds, solves, educates and creates. It covers the headquarters, three characters who represent the brand and the devices the company is known for. Tap any image to enlarge it.

The characters

Amara

Business owner character · Age 27, Nigerian entrepreneur

Intelligent, ambitious, independent, warm and tech-aware. Her sheet shows her in consultations, checking a dashboard and looking out over the Lagos skyline.

Mike

Technology Specialist · Age 26 to 29, Nigerian

“Builds the technology that powers ideas.” Skills: software and web development, AI systems, automation, APIs and integrations, data systems and troubleshooting.

Nadine

Content Creator & Technology Educator · Age 24 to 28, Nigerian

“Turning technology into understandable stories.” Skills: technology education, video production, social media content, AI and automation explainers and digital storytelling.

Each sheet follows the same format: front, three-quarter and side portraits, full-body views, a set of expressions, a character profile and a colour palette. That keeps every character looking the same across all scenes.
